moments.text: Colour sensor view with crosshair and north marker, redaction boxes at the edges. The opening seconds are a blurred, blue-tinted view sliding over the ground.
A small dark round spot appears right of the crosshair over pale ground; it wanders around the crosshair while blurred terrain rushes past.
The picture jumps to a different patch of ridged ground.
The view steps wider; the spot is now a small dark dot just left of the crosshair.
The view steps in from a sharp rocky ledge to a blurred close-up; the dark spot shows again, left of the crosshair.
Close look: the round dark spot wanders left, above and right of the crosshair as the sensor keeps re-centring on it.
The view steps out again; the spot shrinks to a tiny dark dot left of the crosshair.
The picture flickers: brown, black, then white for a few frames. Use frame step.
A wider, sharper purple-grey view of folded terrain follows; the spot can no longer be picked out.
